name: B10-0197/2024 (PfE) – The increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Iran's treatment of women and girls. It calls on Iran to end forced veiling and laws that discriminate against women, and to release detained European Union nationals and political prisoners. It asks European Union countries to add more Iranian officials to sanctions lists. It also urges European Union institutions and member states not to fund any campaign that presents the hijab as something to celebrate. The text is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- The text asks Iran to scrap forced veiling and discriminatory laws; nothing changes automatically.
- It targets Iranian officials for sanctions and European Union funding of hijab campaigns.
- European Union governments decide on sanctions; the Parliament only urges them.
